_comment: T-719 The Shallow Graves — the tutorial capstone's spawn set, seeded by instance_service._seed on a sub-CRYPT_MIN_LEVEL descent (KIND_TRIAL). It occupies the SAME prop_hollowed_crypt box at world (420,0) as the L12 Hollowed Crypt, in a DIFFERENT instance: the two never share an instance_id, so the geometry is reused with zero new art and a graduate never stands among the L15 packs. Only the UPPER galleries are populated (vestibule -> gallery A -> side crypt -> chamber 1, blender rooms VEST/GALA/SIDE/BOSS1 in gen_hollowed_crypt_real.py); everything past y=-16 is left dark, which is the fiction Osric's turn-in sells as the reason to come back at L12. SPACING (the T-628 inversion): TRIAL_ENTRANCE (420,0.2) is 7.17m from the nearest husk, the pack is 7.96m from each boss and the two bosses are 10.82m apart — every gap clears ServerConfig.AGGRO_FLOOR (5.0) by >=2m, so nothing chain-pulls and the respawn point is never inside a pack. Both bosses are additionally retaliate_only. Positions convert from the crypt GLB's Blender-local coords by world=(420+bx, -by).
_respawn_comment: T-725 (owner-decided 2026-08-09): LONG DWELL. The husk pack carries respawn_ticks 6000 = 300s at ServerConfig.TICK_RATE_HZ 20, ten times the global MOB_RESPAWN_TICKS default (600 = 30s) that is tuned for open-world density. A first-timer who reads quest text or fights carefully clears toward Ost without the gallery re-aggroing from behind. The two BOSSES deliberately omit the key and keep the default: boss lifecycle is encounter-scoped (retaliate_only, one pull, dungeon_loot schedule) and this ticket must not touch it. Authored per-ENTRY, not per-instance-kind, so the dwell is data the designer tunes rather than a kind-switch in instance_service.
